Perfect! Done. I've added the render module with `renderInvoiceText(invoice)`:

**src/render.js** — formats an invoice as plain text:
- First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if unsent)
- Second line: customer name
- One line per invoice item showing: qty × product name @ unit price = line total
- Last line: Total: <amount>
- All amounts formatted via formatEuros with € symbols, thousand separators, and 2 decimals

Example output:
```
INV-2026-0001
Northwind Studio
5 x Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €425.00
Total: €425.00
```

Added 15 comprehensive tests covering draft/issued invoices, single/multiple lines, different VAT rates, large/small amounts, and immutability. All 78 tests pass ✓
